reviews.t: Order these, you won’t regret it!!!
reviews.x: These lashes are so amazing and so quick for me to put on. I’ve used several lashes, magnetic and not and these totally are within my top 3 lashes for a quick fix which totally brings my look to another level!

reviews.t: Great once you get the hang of them
reviews.x: These are a great concept. I like that you don't need magnetic eyeliner. It took me awhile to get the hang of them, but then they were easy once i figured them out. I really have to make sure i look down before i close the applicator or else my eyes flutter too much. I will probably trim the lashes a little as they are a bit too much for me.

Ok, I use magnetic lashes like, a LOT. These are really nice for the price. I’m impressed with the quality of the lashes and love the tool it comes with to put them on. Yes, it takes practice.. but it’s worth it!

The applicator that comes with the lashes set the two layers of lashes in place.  The package comes with 2 sets of lashes, but each set has several layers.  This allows the user to have a subtle look or a dramatic look.  The magnets on the lashes are strategically placed and hold well on my natural lashes.  The lash set is nicely packaged.
I was skeptical after watching many youtube videos on how to apply magnetic lashes. But when these arrived I was delighted to find out that they were so easy to apply. Highly recommend!

I've tried various magnetic lashes before but only with applying a magnetic eyeliner first. I love the simplicity of these lashes. It took a few tries of practice before I was able to line them up well on the lash line with application, but once I did they looked great. Nice hold and felt comfortable to wear. Definitely read the included instructions, they have important tips for alignment.
These magnetic eyelashes are so well packaged and can be a great gift! No glue required, just ready to use at any time. These were a little long for me so I trimmed them further. Try it out!
Once you figure out how it goes on, it is easy to use. Very fast delivery. I encountered an issue, and they fixed it right away.
I actually really like these! They aren’t over the top, but give just the right amount of volume! Easy application.
Bought as a gift for my gf she liked them a lot

reviews.t: Took a bit of practice for this newbie but much simpler traditional ones
reviews.x: So I’ll be honest and there was plenty of user error as a newer fake eyelash user. They are magnetic and VERY forgiving if your new to the game. Novice users will probably have no issues. For the price your definitely getting a good deal for reusable magnetic lashes. Nice addition for a quick add to a more minimal makeup user for some extra glam!
These are FLAWLESS and SUPER easy to put on! I used to spend tons getting my lashes done NEVER AGAIN!!

Okay I previously reviewed these Lashes as the wrong ones ( I've recently purchased many different brands) These MAGNETIC lashes which use NO bond agent of any type other than just magnet to magnet connection!!! There's no messy attempt at liquid liners and they last SOOOO much longer and you get SOOOO !any more uses out of them than any other brand I've tried!!! The price is amazing compared with the quality of the product!! The consumer is winning here!!! Although the directions could of been
Magnetic eyelashes are so easy to use and eliminate sticky glue and accidental globs. These look great and stay on well!

Super easy to use, this is the first time I have used fake lashes. I did not use the tool it came with found it easier to apply without it. But they look great and natural. If you follow the instructions on separating it makes it easier. Highly recommend
These came quickly and perfectly packaged. Straight forward application- even for a newbie. Realistic and comfortable!

I've never worn false lashes, so this was a first. I watched a few YouTube videos on how to put these dual magnetic lashes on. It took like 5 or 6 tries, but on the 7th try, oh my goodness! These are great! I did have to trim the edges a little to fit my eyelids, but otherwise these are amazing. Great invention. I've seen my friends fiddle with glue and I used to think it looked like such a hassle so I stuck with 4D mascera which is a 3-step process. Now that I have the hang of these, it takes l

The applicator doesn't work at all.  I had to apply them with tweezers.  Know that you absolutely have to put mascara on because otherwise the upper lash won't stay in place while you are doing the lower lash.  These take a ton of practice to apply.  Definitely a learning curve.  They were also too long for my eyelid, but you can't cut them or otherwise you cut the magnet off.  I ended up having to cut them in the middle and overlap.

First of all, the product arrived damaged. The product was wrapped in thin packaging paper and when I opened it, the mirror was broken. Second, it’s not as easy to put on as advertised. I attempted it several times and when I finally applied them, they didn’t feel comfortable at all. I would not recommend this product at all.

These do not apply to the shape of your eye. The magnets aren’t in the ends, so they stick out and look terrible. I have no clue if you can return them after opening, so definitely do not waste your time and money. I used YouTube videos to teach me how to use them, but they will not sit right no matter what.

This kit makes it easy to use and comes with a simple instruction card that explains how to use it. Box comes with a little mirror attached which makes convenient. I think they could have made the box smaller since there is a lot of foam space thats not really needed but overall it's a good product.

Love this product!  I’ve tried several others that claim to provide the same benefits and I end up disappointed and throw them away.  I’m glad I gave SUALSOCE a try.  This eye cream does not leave the weird chalky residue that most of them do.  This product is a must have for me now.

I was so excited to get these! When they arrived I tried them right away. Unfortunately they didn’t work. I followed the instructions and tried both sets. Neither wanted to connect together. I tried everything to make these work, but they didn’t.

It took me several tries to get them to work, but honestly once you get the hang of them it’s SO EASY! They look amazing and get tons of compliments! Way cheaper than getting extensions and much more gentle on your eyelashes!

The packaging on this product is awful, its a struggle to get the lashes out of their little plastic containers.  I've attempted to put the lashes on but they don't adhere correctly to my lash line. Will not purchase again.

claims.text: Reviewers frequently describe the lashes as easy to apply, especially once they get the hang of them.
Many reviewers note that it takes some practice to learn how to apply them before they become easy.
Reviewers praise the natural, great-looking results and good hold.
Several reviewers appreciate that no glue or magnetic eyeliner is needed.
A few reviewers mention trimming the lashes because they were too long.
